title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) in Computational Pathology: Definitions, Taxonomy, and Recommendations
abstract: arXiv:2608.28820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational pathology (CompPath) is transforming medicine by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to support diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment prediction from gigapixel whole-slide images. Clinical adoption is progressing, but is constrained by concerns about safety, accountability, and regulatory oversight in high-stakes clinical environments. Explainable AI (XAI) systems hold promise for building trust and enabling verification, yet the literature remains fragmented due to inconsistent terminology, overlapping methodological families, ad hoc validation, and current reviews. translated_title: 计算病理学中的可解释人工智能（XAI）：定义、分类法与建议
translated_abstract: 计算病理学（CompPath）正在变革医学，它利用人工智能算法从千兆像素级的全切片图像中支持诊断、预后和治疗预测。临床应用虽在持续推进，但在高风险的临床环境中，人们对安全性、责任归属和监管审查的担忧制约了其发展。可解释人工智能（XAI）系统有望建立信任并实现验证，然而由于术语不一致、方法学家族相互重叠、临时性验证以及现有综述的局限性，相关文献仍呈现碎片化状态。本综述旨在通过以下方式规范计算病理学中的XAI方法：i）引入一套以病理学为中心、包含七个核心术语的词汇表；ii）构建一个跨越各方法学家族及三个正交维度（阶段、类型、范围）的分类体系；iii）建立一个任务驱动的框架，将五个临床问题映射到相应的方法建议。
tldr: 本综述通过提出以病理学为中心的术语体系、构建覆盖三个正交维度的XAI方法分类法，以及建立将五个临床问题映射到方法建议的任务驱动框架，系统性地规范了计算病理学中的可解释人工智能研究。
en_tdlr: This review systematizes explainable AI (XAI) in computational pathology by introducing a pathology-centric vocabulary, developing a taxonomy across methodological families and three orthogonal axes, and establishing a task-driven framework that maps five clinical questions to methodological recommendations.
